concepts.name: 구름 위 수정 폭포
concepts.theme: An open cloud-top pale ivory stone terrace on floating sky islands. At far left a small curved vine-covered ruined arch, at far right a restrained cluster of blue-violet crystals. In the distant upper-right background a slender turquoise waterfall pours from a floating garden island into white clouds. Distant soft sky-blue silhouettes of floating islands and a tiny crystal temple, airy blue sky, warm daylight, fresh muted mint foliage. Central background is luminous pale clouds and sky. The flat battle lane is a simple weathered-but-clean ivory stone walkway with broad stones and tiny mint grass only at its edges. Adventurous, airy and refreshing.
concepts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Wordoria Crystal Quest World 3 ordinary battle background design proposal, landscape 16:9.
WORDORIA CRYSTAL QUEST STYLE — a bright premium 2D anime fantasy illustration for a polished mobile RPG, clean colored linework with dark violet outer contours, crisp three-step soft cel shading, selective smooth gradients on crystal light and magical glow, large readable silhouette, elegant rounded shapes contrasted with a few clean crystal facets, luminous violet and blue crystal glass, restrained mint magical rim light, moon-white resting areas, vivid but controlled color, friendly adventurous mood, highly readable at mobile size, original IP design, consistent production-game asset quality.
Environment rendering: bright clean animation fantasy background, softer thinner lines and lower saturation and contrast than foreground characters. Soft upper-left daylight, cool violet shadows, restrained cyan-mint reflections. Three layers: sparse edge-framing foreground, clean walkable middle-ground battle lane, distant atmospheric environment. 
Critical gameplay framing: horizontal SIDE VIEW battle stage, camera at character height, not overhead, not a world map, not an isometric diorama. A wide continuous level battle floor spans the entire width in bottom 25 percent. Main ground line at about 85 percent image height. Leave central 75 percent width quiet and open with pale softly rendered scenery behind future character heads; future hero stands left and monster group right. Put crystals and pillars mainly at outer edges or distant background, never blocking either fighter. No huge central foreground crystal. Full bleed opaque environment.
No characters, monsters, text, labels, UI, borders, logos or watermarks. No pixel art, realistic 3D, low-poly toy render, black comic outlines, gritty darkness, horror, excessive bloom, oversaturated neon, dirty textures, dense tiny clutter, steep stairs in the playable floor, or exaggerated vanishing-point floor.

concepts.name: 크리스탈 사원 회랑
concepts.theme: A luminous ancient crystal temple courtyard high above the clouds, open sided. Pale moon-white stone architecture and violet-blue stained crystal windows, simple refined restrained gold fittings. Tall elegant columns frame only outermost left and right edges. Distant arches form a calm broad background with cloud sky visible, soft light rays entering upper left. A small suspended faceted crystal high in a distant rear arch provides theme without dominating. The floor is a level wide pale lavender-white stone platform with very subtle broad tile seams; no busy floor patterns. Regal yet welcoming magical sanctuary, softly luminous ivory with pale lavender and mint accents.

concepts.name: 숨겨진 민트 수정 동굴
concepts.theme: A bright secret crystal cave in a floating sky island. Rounded blue-lavender stone cavern softly frames upper corners, restrained large violet-blue crystal formations at extreme left and right edges, a distant shallow turquoise stream and a soft illuminated moon-white cave opening in rear center. Pale mist depth, mint bounce light gently illuminates broad smooth rocks. Floor is a continuous flat broad muted lavender stone ledge with a calm pale mint light band at its edge. Cavern remains brightly visible and friendly, no black shadows, no horror, no dense pointy crystal clutter. Mysterious sparkling discovery atmosphere, clear silhouette backdrop for dark purple one-eyed serpent enemies.
